mechanism: Celecoxib inhibits renal prostaglandin synthesis, reducing sodium and water excretion and antagonizing the diuretic and antihypertensive effects of chlorthalidone, while increasing risk of renal impairment and hyperkalemia.
action: Monitor blood pressure, renal function, and electrolytes closely; use lowest effective celecoxib dose for shortest duration; consider alternative analgesic; ensure adequate hydration.
